attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count is dominated by encoder invocation overhead and processed tile area, with separate costs for first and subsequent temporal chunks.

pcvs.name: spatial_tiles
pcvs.rationale: Counts first-chunk encoder calls and per-tile setup.

pcvs.name: cached_tile_chunks
pcvs.rationale: Counts subsequent four-frame encoder calls with populated caches.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * ((x.shape[3] - 1) // self.tile_sample_stride_height * self.tile_sample_min_height + (x.shape[3] - 1) % self.tile_sample_stride_height + 1) * ((x.shape[4] - 1) // self.tile_sample_stride_width * self.tile_sample_min_width + (x.shape[4] - 1) % self.tile_sample_stride_width + 1)
pcvs.name: first_chunk_tile_area
pcvs.rationale: Total processed spatial area including overlap and clipped boundary tiles for the fixed workload; captures size-dependent first-chunk computation.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * ((x.shape[3] - 1) // self.tile_sample_stride_height * self.tile_sample_min_height + (x.shape[3] - 1) % self.tile_sample_stride_height + 1) * ((x.shape[4] - 1) // self.tile_sample_stride_width * self.tile_sample_min_width + (x.shape[4] - 1) % self.tile_sample_stride_width + 1) * ((x.shape[2] - 1) // 4)
pcvs.name: cached_chunk_tile_area
pcvs.rationale: Spatial work across subsequent chunks, whose temporal convolution and cache costs differ from the first chunk.
